shortlist.label: Melanonychia
shortlist.why_kept: Progressive pigmented nail lesion with nail thickening

shortlist.label: Onychomatricoma
shortlist.why_kept: Bland spindle cell proliferation within the nail matrix

shortlist.label: Nail matrix nevus
shortlist.why_kept: Pigmented lesion with corresponding nail thickening

shortlist.label: Subungual hematoma
shortlist.why_kept: Intracorneal hemorrhage and adjacent verrucous hyperkeratosis present

shortlist.label: Onychocytic matricoma
shortlist.why_kept: Villous fibroepithelial projections into the nail plate without melanocytic proliferation

raw.rationale: The presence of a bland spindle cell proliferation within the nail matrix, villous fibroepithelial projections into the nail plate, and corresponding nail thickening are characteristic features of onychomatricoma, which is a rare benign tumor of the nail matrix.

rejected.label: Melanonychia
rejected.why: No melanocytic lesions were observed on histopathologic examination, and immunostaining was negative for S100, which is a marker for melanocytes.

rejected.label: Nail matrix nevus
rejected.why: The absence of melanocytic proliferation and negative immunostaining for S100 and CD34 argue against a nevus.

rejected.label: Subungual hematoma
rejected.why: The presence of a progressively growing lesion with corresponding nail thickening and the specific histopathologic findings are not consistent with a hematoma, which would typically be associated with trauma and have a different appearance.

rejected.label: Onychocytic matricoma
rejected.why: While onychocytic matricoma is a consideration, the specific histopathologic features described, such as villous fibroepithelial projections, are more characteristic of onychomatricoma.
